enchantments.tooltip: Lesser Displacement: Equipping this item causes light to distort around you. Attacks from enemies have a 25% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Dexterity +14: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Physical Sheltering +37: +37 Enhancement bonus to Physical Resistance Rating
Magical Sheltering +37: +37 Enhancement bonus to Magical Resistance Rating
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
